# CDL Entry Level Driver Training (ELDT): Hazmat (H) Endorsement

> 5-hour online entry-level driver training theory for the CDL Hazardous Materials (H) endorsement, in line with FMCSA regulations and the DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations, 49 CFR Parts 171-180. Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com), listed on the FMCSA Training Provider Registry.

## Key facts
- Duration: 5 hours; 5 modules, 13 lessons, final exam (80% to pass)
- Credits: 0.5 CEU
- Price: $79.99 per person; bulk pricing from 2 seats
- Delivery: 100% online, 24/7, mobile-friendly, audio playback
- Reporting: records sent to the FMCSA Training Provider Registry on passing
- Required since February 2022 before taking the H endorsement knowledge test
- Also required: state H knowledge test; TSA security threat assessment (repeated at endorsement renewal)
- Behind-the-wheel training: not included
- State acceptance: every state except Washington
- Prerequisite: valid commercial driver's license

## Modules
1. Hazmat Basic Requirements and Communication (introductory and operational requirements; reporting crashes and releases)
2. Safe Transportation Practices (tunnels and rail crossings; loading and unloading; hazmat on passenger vehicles; bulk packages)
3. Emergency Preparedness and Response (operating emergency equipment; emergency response procedures)
4. Pre-Trip and Operational Considerations (engine fueling; tire check)
5. Planning and Permits (routes and route planning; Hazardous Materials Safety Permits)

## Who should take it
Commercial drivers who may haul hazardous materials: hazmat delivery and tanker drivers, liquid and gas haulers, energy company drivers, hazardous waste transporters, and specialized haulers (for example mining explosives or medical radioactive materials).
